runs.verdict: The pipeline works end to end (still -> Grok I2V -> project-clips asset with cost) through the AVT route; the CC route is broken until the fix is deployed. The clip is not usable as a production shot: the smile contradicts the brief and the single hand is inherited. Identity and scene hold over 2 s, which is what this test was meant to measure.
